lanes.summary: I have thoroughly reviewed the diff against the RHLGA-1 ticket and its sub-tasks (HOSTDEP-1, RAWIDENT-2, GLOBALSHADOW-1, RETUNIT-1, BLOCKFOR-1). The diff perfectly matches the acceptance criteria. It replaces 'ruchy' commands with 'CARGO_BIN_EXE_ruchy', properly ignores named-environment tests, scales back cli_unify_003 spawns, fixes glob expansion in test 03, enforces safe identifiers for bindings and correct `__global_` emission/shadowing logic for mutable globals, correctly restores token position for blocks containing for loops misparsed as set comprehensions, and refines the numeric-name type inference heuristic. All findings align exactly with the receipt and ticket requirements.

findings.claim: HOSTDEP-1: Workspace tests spawn env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_ruchy") and named-environment tests are ignored
findings.fix: Tests replacing Command::new("ruchy") with the built binary were verified in variables_test.rs and other matrix/issue tests. The ignore tags for llvm-profdata and renacer were properly added to opt_global_001_pgo.rs and tooling_002_renacer_integration.rs.

findings.claim: RAWIDENT-2: Parameters and bindings correctly go through safe_ident
findings.fix: safe_ident was verified to be used across function, method, actor-handler, effect, closure parameters, for variables, patterns and catch bindings.

findings.claim: GLOBALSHADOW-1: Mutable globals are emitted as static __global_<name> and with_globals_shadowed hides names from global_vars for bindings
findings.fix: Mutable globals correctly use global_static_ident (which translates to __global_{name}), and with_globals_shadowed is correctly used across let bindings, function parameters, and pattern/for loops (via with_string_scope).

findings.claim: RETUNIT-1: The numeric-name heuristic applies only when the body ends in a value
findings.fix: is_numeric_named_value_function was added and correctly utilized in both standard type inference and the lifetime path (infer_return_type_with_lifetime). tests/g2b_transfix_7.rs includes the appropriate tests.

findings.claim: BLOCKFOR-1: Set-comprehension parser restores token position when failing so the block parser takes it
findings.fix: try_parse_comprehension correctly resets the token position in inspect_err when parsing a set comprehension continuation fails, allowing block parsing to proceed.

lanes.summary: Lane 2 Review Verdict: PASS. Evaluated PR #248 (gate G2c of RHLGA-1 epic, commits origin/RHLGA-G2b-test-suite...HEAD) against ticket RHLGA-1, the implementation receipt, and refutation criteria.
